initial_scene: The humanoid faces the camera behind four upright white paper rolls. The rear-left roll is the manipulated object; another roll immediately to its image right becomes the lower member of the stack. Right hand is at image left and left hand is at image right.

observed_sequence.action: Robot waits with both hands low beside the tabletop/lap; all four rolls rest upright on the tabletop.
Anatomical right arm extends toward the rear-left roll, spreading its fingers around the roll and reaching a digit near its hollow core. Left hand stays low beside the lap.
Right hand establishes and adjusts the grasp around the rear-left roll; the object remains on the table until the lift begins.
Right hand tips the roll sideways, supports it with curled fingers, and lifts it clear of the table. The circular core faces roughly toward the camera during the lift.
Right arm transports the lifted roll over the remaining rear-center roll and lowers it while rotating it back toward upright. Left hand provides no support or transfer.
Right hand brings the upper roll upright on top of the lower roll, opens its fingers, and lifts clear. The upper roll remains upright without hand support.
Right arm retracts downward beside the body; the upper roll stays on the lower roll and the other two rolls remain upright on the table.

arm_hand_roles.right: Only manipulating hand: grasps, tips, lifts, transports, reorients, lowers and releases the rear-left paper roll, then withdraws.
arm_hand_roles.left: Idle low beside the lap throughout; does not stabilize a roll, support the lifted roll, or receive a transfer.
